newsitem.title: USA: Total Renal raises consent payment offer.
newsitem.headline: Total Renal raises consent payment offer.

text.p: Total Renal Care Holdings Inc said Friday it will increase the consent payment to $30 in cash offered for each $1,000 in principal amount of its 12 percent senior subordinated discount notes due 2004 for holders who tender their notes and deliver the related consent prior to the consent solicitation expiration time, which has been extended to 0930 EDT/1330 GMT September 30.
Prior to this announcement the company had offered a consent payment of $20 in cash for each $1,000 in principal amount of discount notes at maturity.
The consent solicitation was previously extended to September 27, Total Renal Care noted.

The company said its offer to purchase the discount notes for a cash purchase price of $1,033.62 per $1,000 principal amount of the discount notes at maturity has been extended to 0930 EDT/1330 GMT October 11.
